events.notes: Composite scheme: Bhagyanagar Copper Pvt Ltd (unlisted, private) amalgamated into BIL (no event: public holders receive nothing), then BIL's copper business demerged into Tieramet Ltd. Cost split 89.36/10.64 comes from a company email to shareholders reproduced on ValuePickr and from Multibagg; no NSE/BSE filing of the apportionment was found, so status left detected. Tieramet not yet listed as of 2026-11-06 (listing application and Rule 19(2)(b) relaxation in progress); ticker/ISIN/listing_date unknown.
